methodologyNotes: Covers 12 notable adult pickleball paddles that buyers commonly cross-shop in 2026, spanning premium thermoformed/foam-core paddles (JOOLA Perseus Pro IV, Selkirk Labs Project 007, CRBN TruFoam Genesis, Gearbox Pro Power Elongated), popular honeycomb-core control/hybrid paddles (Six Zero Double Black Diamond Control, Engage Pursuit Pro EX 6.0, Ronbus R1.16 Pulsar, JOOLA Ben Johns Hyperion CFS, Paddletek Bantam TKO-C), and value/budget picks (Vatic Pro Prism Flash, Franklin Signature Pro, ProKennex Black Ace Pro). Every manufacturer official site in this niche (joola.com, selkirklabs.com, selkirk.com, crbnpickleball.com, sixzeropickleball.com, ronbus.com, paddletek.com, gearboxsports.com, prokennex-pickleball.com, vaticpro.com, elevatepkl.com) returned repeated HTTP 429 bot-blocking to automated fetches during research, so specs and pricing here are sourced from directly-fetched, reputable specialty retailer and paddle-review pages (PickleballCentral, PickleballWarehouse family sites, Pickleheads, DashPickleball, PickleballEffect, TheSlicePickleball) that republish and corroborate manufacturer-issued spec sheets and product photography verbatim; USA Pickleball's own equipment-news article (usapickleball.org) was reachable directly and is cited for the ProKennex delisting. priceUsd is the US list/MSRP for the base configuration described in priceNote (frequently discounted by retailers; the discounted street price seen at access time is noted separately). weight_oz is the manufacturer's published average weight for the base configuration (paddles ship in a small +/- range around this figure). length_in and width_in are overall paddle dimensions in inches. core_thickness_mm is the core gauge in millimeters. paddle_shape is an enum: 'elongated' (extended reach, narrower face), 'standard' (traditional balanced proportions), 'hybrid' (blends elongated length with a wider/rounded face), or 'wide-body' (shorter, wider face for a larger sweet spot). grip_length_in and grip_circumference_in are in inches for the stock/medium grip. spin_rpm is only populated when the brand itself publishes a specific spin-rate claim for that exact paddle (most brands do not disclose one, so this is null for the majority of entries; it is not a reviewer's independently measured figure). usap_approved reflects USA Pickleball (USAP/PBCoR) approved-paddle-list status as understood from the fetched sources at accessedAt: true if explicitly stated approved, false if explicitly delisted/removed, null if not stated in any fetched source (not evidence of non-approval). No Wikimedia Commons photography exists for any of these branded, current-generation paddles (searched and confirmed empty), so every image is the manufacturer's own product photograph as redistributed on the cited retailer/review page, licensed to the respective brand.

products.name: JOOLA Perseus Pro IV
products.priceNote: US MSRP $249.95 for the 16mm Ben Johns Perseus Pro IV, per the PickleballCentral product page. JOOLA's own site (joola.com) blocked automated fetches (HTTP 429) so could not be independently confirmed; a general web search suggested a lower $179.95 figure elsewhere, which could not be verified against a live page and may reflect a different configuration or promotion, so is not used.

specs.face_material: Textured carbon fiber face (TFP / TechFlex Power technology)
specs.core_material: Honeycomb Propulsion polymer core with Hyper-Foam edge wall

products.provenance: PickleballCentral's live product page for the JOOLA Ben Johns Perseus Pro IV 16mm (fetched directly) states an average weight of 8.1oz (7.9-8.3oz range), 16.5in x 7.5in dimensions, a 16mm (0.629in) core, 'Honeycomb Propulsion' core with 'Hyper-Foam Edge Wall', a textured carbon-fiber face, a 5.5in/4.25in grip, and a $249.95 price; it lists the paddle as USAP and UPA-A approved. A general web search independently confirmed the Perseus Pro IV line (14mm and 16mm) is 'UPA-A pro certified and USAP PBCoR .43 certified' per joola.com collection copy, corroborating the approval status, though joola.com itself returned HTTP 429 to direct fetches during this research and could not be used as a primary source. spin_rpm is left null because no fetched source published a specific spin-rate figure for this model.

products.name: Selkirk Labs Project 007
products.priceNote: US MSRP $333 for the 14mm Invikta (elongated) configuration. Selkirk's own sites (selkirk.com, selkirklabs.com) and third-party retailer elevatepkl.com returned HTTP 429 to direct fetches, so the $333 regular price could not be fetched first-hand; it is taken from a general web search of a Holabird Sports price-drop listing ('the regular price is $333'). PickleballCentral's live product page (directly fetched) shows only a current sale price of $149.99 with no MSRP populated in its price fields, illustrating how aggressively this model is discounted at retail.

specs.face_material: Florek carbon fiber face with InfiniGrit textured surface
specs.core_material: Polypropylene honeycomb with a Titanium Mesh Layer System

products.provenance: PickleballCentral's live product page for the Selkirk LABS Project 007 Invikta 14mm (fetched directly) gives an average weight of 8.15oz (7.9-8.4oz range), 16.4in x 7.5in dimensions, a 14mm (.551in) polypropylene-honeycomb core with a titanium mesh layer, a Florek carbon face with InfiniGrit surface, a 5.5in/4.25in grip, USAPA-approved status, and a then-current price of $149.99 with no separate MSRP shown. A general web search of Selkirk's own marketing copy states the InfiniGrit surface delivers 'spin potential of up to 2000 RPMs' (used here as the manufacturer's own claimed ceiling, hence spin_rpm 2000) and that the line is 'USAP, PBCoR, and UPA-A Approved'; the same search surfaced a Holabird Sports listing citing a $333 regular price, used as priceUsd since it is explicitly labeled a regular/MSRP figure rather than a sale price. Selkirk's own domains (selkirk.com, selkirklabs.com, elevatepkl.com) returned HTTP 429 on every direct fetch attempt during this research, so none could serve as the primary verified source.

products.name: CRBN TruFoam Genesis
products.priceNote: US MSRP $279.99, per the PickleballCentral product page for the CRBN³ TruFoam Genesis (Elongated), which matches CRBN's own site pricing for all four TruFoam Genesis shape variants (Elongated, Elongated Long Handle, Square, Hybrid AeroCurve) seen via web search.

specs.face_material: T700 raw carbon fiber with an added fiberglass layer
specs.core_material: TruFoam proprietary high-density foam (100% foam core, no honeycomb)

products.provenance: PickleballCentral's live product page for the CRBN³ TruFoam Genesis (Elongated), fetched directly, gives an average weight of 8.25oz (8.1-8.4oz range), 16.5in x 7.5in dimensions, a 14mm (0.55in) 100%-foam 'TruFoam' core, a T700 raw carbon face with fiberglass, a 5.5in/4.125in ('4 1/8', Small) grip, USAP/UPA-A approved status, and a $279.99 price. A separate web search of crbnpickleball.com's own collection copy independently corroborates the 100%-foam TruFoam construction, the 14mm thickness across the family, and the $279.99 price for all four Genesis shapes, and cites a 2302 RPM / 60 MPH spin-and-speed figure specifically for the 'Genesis 1' (CRBN¹) variant; because that RPM figure was published for a different shape (CRBN¹, not the CRBN³ used here) and the two were not confirmed identical, spin_rpm is left null rather than assumed. crbnpickleball.com itself returned HTTP 429 to direct fetch attempts.

products.name: Engage Pursuit Pro EX 6.0

products.provenance: PickleballDepot's live product page for the Engage Pursuit Pro EX 6.0 (fetched directly) gives a Standard-config weight range of 7.9-8.3oz, a 16in x 8in wide-body profile, a 5/8in (15.875mm) 'Control Pro Black' polymer-honeycomb core, a raw Toray T700 carbon face, a 5in handle with 4 3/8in grip circumference, 'USAPA Listed and Approved for Tournament Play' status, and a $259.99 MSRP (then discounted to $233.99). A general web search of the PickleballCentral listing independently states an 'Average Weight: 8.25 ounces (Standard)' figure (used here as the numeric weight_oz, being the manufacturer's explicit average rather than a range midpoint) alongside the same $259.99 price, 16in x 8in dimensions and 16mm-class core, corroborating PickleballDepot's figures; PickleballCentral's own page returned HTTP 404 on direct fetch so is cited only as search-corroboration, not as the primary source.

products.name: Ronbus R1.16 Pulsar
products.priceNote: US price $120 (regular), discounted to $100 with code DASHPB at Ronbus's own checkout, per DashPickleball's review page which explicitly lists both figures. Amazon separately lists the sibling R1 Pulsar at a higher $170, which may reflect Amazon-specific markup rather than Ronbus's direct-site MSRP; ronbus.com itself returned HTTP 429 to direct fetches so could not confirm which figure is the official MSRP.

specs.face_material: Raw Toray T700 carbon fiber, textured

products.provenance: DashPickleball's Ronbus R1.16 review (fetched directly) states an average weight of 8.2oz, 16.5in length, 7.5in width, a 16mm polypropylene-honeycomb core with raw Toray T700 textured carbon face, a 5.5in/4.25in grip, a swingweight of 117, and pricing of $120 regular / $100 with code DASHPB; it also reports a reviewer-measured spin figure 'over 2100 RPMs', which is explicitly a third-party review measurement rather than a manufacturer-published spec, so it is not used for the spin_rpm field. Pickleheads' independent Ronbus R1 Pulsar review (fetched directly) corroborates the 16mm core, raw Toray T700 carbon fiber, polypropylene-honeycomb core, 16.5in/7.5in dimensions, 5.5in grip length and 4.25in grip circumference, and an 8.1oz weight (within rounding of DashPickleball's 8.2oz). USA Pickleball approval status was not explicitly stated on either fetched page, so it is left null despite the paddle being widely sold as tournament-oriented.

products.name: JOOLA Ben Johns Hyperion CFS
products.priceNote: US MSRP $219.95 for the 16mm Hyperion CFS, per The Dink Pickleball's review (matches PickleballCentral's page, which shows the same paddle marked down to $159.95 at access time). Note: the seed name 'JOOLA Ben Johns Hyperion C2' was corrected to 'Hyperion CFS' — joola.com lists a distinct newer 'Hyperion C2 CFS 14' SKU, but joola.com returned HTTP 429 on every direct-fetch attempt, so its specs could not be verified; the entry here is the well-corroborated, widely-reviewed original Hyperion CFS 16 that both fetched sources independently confirm in full detail.

specs.core_material: Reactive polymer honeycomb core with Hyperfoam edge wall

products.name: ProKennex Black Ace Pro
products.priceNote: US MSRP $250, per Pickleheads' review (directly fetched), which notes it is 'often discounted to $150-200' at retail; a separate general web search saw it listed around $149.99-$225 at various retailers.

specs.face_material: Toray T700 carbon fiber (single-piece molded, edgeless)

products.provenance: Pickleheads' review of the ProKennex Black Ace Pro (fetched directly) gives a 7.95oz weight, 15.8in length, 7.6in width, 5.33in handle length, 4in grip circumference, a 10mm (0.39in) polypropylene-honeycomb core under a one-piece molded Toray carbon-fiber face, a $250 price (often discounted to $150-200), and explicitly states: 'the ProKennex Black Ace Pro was delisted for tournament use by USA Pickleball on July 1, 2025.' USA Pickleball's own equipment-news article (usapickleball.org, fetched directly) confirms this: reporting on its reversal for the sibling 11mm Black Ace LG, it explicitly states that ProKennex's other 11mm-class models — 'Black Ace Pro, Black Ace Ovation and Black Ace XF' — 'will remain unchanged and will be delisted on July 1, 2025,' i.e. the Black Ace Pro remains off USA Pickleball's approved-paddle list as of this dataset's access date. usap_approved is therefore set to false (not null) since this is an explicit, dated, authoritative determination rather than an absence of information. No manufacturer spin-rate figure was found, so spin_rpm is null.
